rules.condition: The farmer's family (husband, wife, minor children) owns cultivable land as per the land records of the concerned State/UT.
The land is held by an institution rather than an individual/family (institutional land holders are excluded).
Any member of the family paid income tax in the last assessment year.
If a family member is a superannuated/retired pensioner, their monthly pension (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees).
A family member is a former/present holder of a constitutional post, Minister/State Minister, MP/MLA/MLC, Mayor of a Municipal Corporation, or Chairperson of a District Panchayat.

A family member is a serving or retired officer/employee of Central/State Government Ministries, Offices, Departments, PSEs, or Local Bodies (excludes Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees).
A family member is a practicing professional (Doctor, Engineer, Lawyer, Chartered Accountant, or Architect) registered with a professional body.

notes: For new beneficiaries, Non-Resident Indian (NRI) land-holding families are excluded (page 3). Not modelled as a rule because it depends on residency/citizenship status, which the eligibility checker's profile fields (income, land, category, location, age) do not currently capture.

Special alternate eligibility mechanisms apply in parts of the North-East (Manipur, Nagaland, community land ownership) and Jharkhand (Vanshavali/lineage-based verification) — pages 5–6. Not modelled as they are procedural/regional exceptions, not eligibility thresholds.
Benefit amount (Rs.6000/year in 3 installments) and the 01.02.2019 eligibility cut-off date (page 2–3) are scheme facts, not eligibility criteria for the checker.
